title.description: One line naming the task, which the delegation is listed by.

instruction.description: The task, with every piece of context it needs: what to find or do, where, on which machine, and what the answer must hold. The run sees nothing of the conversation.

role.description: The role whose run carries the task, on that role's own provider order; where none is named, the delegator role, your own double on your own provider and model.

folder.description: Where to work; the asking supervisor's scratch workspace where none is named.
